name: HotpotQA
intro: HotpotQA 从 2017-10-01 英文 Wikipedia 首段超链接图采样桥接型与比较型段落对，由众包人员编写多跳问题、答案和句级支持事实。112,779 个有效样本经人工与三折模型难度划分后，在干扰段落和全 Wikipedia 两种设置下评估答案、支持事实及联合 EM/F1。
build_method: Wikipedia超链接图采样, 众包多跳出题, 模型辅助难度划分
metric: 答案EM/F1, 支持事实EM/F1, 联合EM/F1
task_type: 多跳问答, 阅读理解
build_method_en: Wikipedia hyperlink-graph sampling, crowdsourced multi-hop questions, model-assisted hardness splits
intro_en: HotpotQA samples bridge and comparison paragraph pairs from a first-paragraph hyperlink graph of the October 1, 2017 English Wikipedia dump. Crowdworkers write multi-hop questions, answers, and sentence-level supporting facts. Its 112,779 valid examples are hardness-partitioned and evaluated in distractor and full-wiki settings with answer, support, and joint EM/F1.
metric_en: Answer EM/F1, Supporting-fact EM/F1, Joint EM/F1

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:1809.09600v1 Sections 2, 3, and 5 plus Appendix A, and official code commit 3635853 including hotpot_evaluate_v1.py. The October 1, 2017 English Wikipedia dump is reduced to first paragraphs and hyperlinks; 591 bridge categories are manually curated. Collection samples bridge pairs with probability 75% and comparison pairs from 42 entity lists with probability 25%, with half of comparison questions using Yes/No answers. AMT workers using ParlAI provide questions, answers, and sentence-level supporting facts. Of 112,779 valid examples, 18,089 mostly single-hop items form train-easy, three-fold model filtering yields 56,814 train-medium items, and hard items split into train-hard 15,661, dev 7,405, test-distractor 7,405, and test-fullwiki 7,405. Distractor evaluation shuffles two gold and eight TF-IDF paragraphs; full-wiki evaluation does not specify gold paragraphs. The evaluator computes answer EM/F1, support EM/F1, and joint metrics from answer/support precision and recall products. Public train and dev data are CC BY-SA 4.0; test answers and supporting facts are withheld, with Docker code submitted for distractor testing and predictions submitted for full-wiki testing.
